column1: # NTVMR transcriptions read by research track 5 (docs/data/scripture-research-class-a.md).
# Institut für Neutestamentliche Textforschung, New Testament Virtual Manuscript
# Room, CC BY 4.0 (each file's TEI header states it). Fetched from the API url,
# checked against sha256 and bytes, cached under <cache>/ntvmr/<sha256>.xml;
# never committed. Rows are every Greek continuous-text manuscript the NTVMR
# catalogue lists as containing Mark 16:8 or John 7:52, dated to AD 1000 or
# earlier (plus P66 and P75 for John), whose published transcription of the
# two chapters has text; chapters in order.
